summary: The article accurately reports Signature Global's Q1 FY27 pre-sales figures and their comparison to previous quarters, attributing the QoQ growth to the Tonino Lamborghini Residences launch. The information aligns with multiple financial news sources.

claims.claim: Signature Global reported pre-sales of ₹1,970 crore for Q1 FY27, indicating strong operational activity.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm Signature Global's Q1 FY27 pre-sales at ₹1,970 crore.

claims.claim: This figure represents a robust 25% quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) growth, suggesting positive momentum.
claims.note: The 25% QoQ growth is consistently reported across various financial news outlets.

claims.claim: However, the pre-sales were 25% lower on a year-on-year (YoY) basis compared to Q1 FY26.
claims.note: Several sources confirm the 25% YoY decline in pre-sales for Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26.

claims.claim: The launch of Tonino Lamborghini Residences was a significant contributor to the QoQ sales surge.
claims.note: News reports explicitly state the Tonino Lamborghini Residences launch as a key driver for the QoQ growth.

claims.claim: Signature Global's net debt increased to ₹390 crore as of June 30, 2026, compared to ₹200 crore at the end of the previous fiscal year.
claims.note: Livemint and other financial news sources report this increase in net debt.

claims.claim: The company sold 226 units during the quarter, compared with 778 units a year ago and 378 units in the preceding quarter, while the area sold fell to 0.72 million sq. ft. from 1.62 million sq. ft. a year earlier and 1 million sq. ft. in Q4 FY26.
claims.note: These figures for units sold and area sold are consistent across multiple reports.

article_title: Signature Global Q1 FY27 Pre-Sales: A Closer Look at Growth
